posts.title: JekyllStudio is a local-only macOS editor designed for writing and editing Jekyll blog posts
posts.description: I’ve been using Jekyll since 2009 (17 years at time of writing!) and it remains my favourite way to publish on the web. Jekyll’s appeal lies in its philosophy . Your content lives on disk as plain files, they get generated into a static site, and that generated site can be pushed to any web server. No databases, no admin panels, and your blog posts still get pretty permalinks. The elegance of Jeky

posts.title: Tailscale sidecar pattern for Synology NAS with DSM 7 and Container Manager
posts.description: Tailscale lets you connect your devices over the internet as if they were on the same local network. Its MagicDNS feature gives each device a stable hostname so you can reach them with something like foo.yourtailnet.ts.net instead of an IP address. It’s convenient and private. I use Container Manager on my Synology NAS to self-host services. Tailscale can be installed as a client directly into DSM
